section.title: Document content
section.p: This guide describes how to configure and manage alarms in the , including setting up alarm extensions, routing alarms via AlarmService, and handling alarm states, acknowledgments, and escalations. It covers integration with Orion databases for archiving, secure email and SMS notifications, and the OnCallService for scheduled, priority-based alerting. The guide also details alarm components, recipient types, and plugin views to support flexible and scalable alarm workflows in building automation systems.
